item.title: EplayerX 1.2.22
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 改善剧集详情的续播与选集，准确衔接本地播放记录和 Trakt 进度，减少切换资源或返回详情后选错集的问题。 - 优化剧集资源版本与媒体信息展示，提升切换剧集、加载片源时的状态一致性。 - 改善下载恢复与重试，减少任务中断后停滞或进度显示异常的问题。 - 修复杜比视界视频解码回退可能被覆盖的问题，提升播放兼容性。 - 修复 MoviePilot 管理员查看和管理其他用户及插件订阅的兼容性问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Improved episode selection and resume behavior by keeping local playback records and Trakt progress in sync, reducing incorrect episode selections after switching sources or returning to details. - Refined episode resource versions and media information, with more consistent state when switching episodes and loading playback sources. - Improved download recovery and retries, reducing stalled tasks and incorrect progress after interruptions. - Fixed an issue that could override Dolby Vision decoder fallback, improving playback compatibility. - Fixed MoviePilot compatibility for administrators viewing and managing subscriptions from other users and plugins.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
